name: blender install preferences and viewport basics
goal: Install Blender, set useful preferences, and learn viewport nav plus G/R/S and Object/Edit mode.

outputs.name: configured_blender
outputs.description: Blender with saved prefs and basic nav competence

constraints: Tab toggles Object/Edit; T toggles toolbar; N toggles sidebar

steps.action: Download Blender from blender.org and install for your OS; open and click outside splash to dismiss.
Edit → Preferences → Interface: adjust Resolution Scale if UI is tiny/huge.
Preferences → System: enable CUDA/GPU Cycles device if available; raise Undo Steps (e.g. 100); Save Preferences.
Viewport: MMB orbit, Shift+MMB pan, scroll zoom; optional gizmo orbit/zoom/pan; numpad/gizmo axis views.
Learn Move/Rotate/Scale tools and hotkeys G, R, S; axis-constrain with X/Y/Z; Tab for Edit mode.

verification: Can orbit/pan/zoom and G/R/S the default cube
